description: One match: kickoff, teams, competition, the cheapest price we hold at each ticket seller, the venue and any available travel directions. `url` is the match's page on weekendgoals.com, listing every seller and price we hold.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: the one the user wrote their budget in or uses where they are. When absent, maxPrice's currency, else USD.
